secret.title: The secret phrase
secret.hint: Record a word or a short phrase without the imitator hearing it. You have 10 seconds.
secret.recorded: Recorded. Nobody hears it the right way round until the end.

imitate.title: Listen and imitate
imitate.hint: It plays backwards. Listen as often as you like, then record yourself repeating exactly what you hear.

reveal.title: What did you say?
reveal.hint: First the real phrase, then your imitation turned around.

errors.denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it for this site in your browser settings and try again.
errors.unavailable: No microphone found, or another app is using it. Close it and try again.
errors.unsupported: This browser can't record audio. Try an up-to-date Chrome or Safari.
errors.saving: The recording couldn't be saved. Record it again.
